objective: Project members can safely maintain stage announcements and see theme-responsive release-calendar dates without changing global theme behavior.

requirements.statement: Project detail retains its announcement-management tab and existing tab routes.
acceptance: The announcement tab opens through tab=announcements and existing tabs remain available.
counterexample: An existing tab route changes or the announcement tab is unavailable.

requirements.statement: Project members can persist project-owned stage announcements with title, safe rich text and pinning.
acceptance: Member create, edit, pin and delete operations survive refresh.
counterexample: Announcement data is lost or reused from another module.

requirements.statement: Announcement reads and writes enforce server-side project membership, tenant, stage and lock boundaries.
acceptance: Non-members, cross-tenant callers, invalid stages and stale writes are rejected.
counterexample: A frontend-visible control allows an unauthorized write.

requirements.statement: The overview shows only announcements for top-level plan stages active on the current date, with pinned items first.
acceptance: Parallel active stages are included and absent stages show an explicit empty result.
counterexample: Historical or future-stage notices appear as current.

requirements.statement: Announcement and overview experiences remain safely rendered and responsive.
acceptance: Unsafe markup does not execute and desktop plus required mobile viewports have no page-level horizontal overflow.
counterexample: A script executes from announcement content or the page overflows horizontally.

requirements.statement: Release-calendar maintenance offers five internal color families whose saved date boxes follow the active global palette and appearance.
acceptance: Only five swatch-led internal families appear for new writes.
Changing global palette or light/dark appearance recolors existing boxes without resaving.
counterexample: Global palette names are selectable for a release entry.
Date-box colors stay fixed after theme changes.

invariants: Project API paths, theme_key column, authorization and audit behavior remain compatible.
No global theme module, migration or unrelated working-tree change is modified.
constraints: Writes are limited to REQ-083 scope.
Use existing Vue/Element Plus and active CSS variables.
Do not read .env or access production data.

assumptions.text: Every selectable global theme defines brand, success, accent, warning and danger variables in both appearances.
assumptions.falsifier: Computed values are missing or unreadable for a supported palette/appearance.
